system.description:
The marksmen of the Boldock Wall and Westfront Fort, who learned precision over years of watching the Red Waste for movement.

  • Patient Aim: Dead Eye also works on a turn you moved 5ft or less.
    • 9th level: Dead Aim (3rd level: Advantage and +1d6 when you did not move or attack last turn) now also works if you moved 5ft or less last turn.
  • Sentry's Eye: Advantage on checks to estimate range and identify distant targets, and on Perception checks on watch or sentry duty.
